channel.title: Gursimran Singh — Blog

item.title: How I Built GadgetSimplify with Claude Code in 2 Hours
item.description: Why I built GadgetSimplify, a gadget explainer site with a buying verdict on every review, and how Claude Code helped me ship it in under two hours.

item.title: Unit Testing a React App with AI: 0 to 1,676 Tests
item.description: How I used Claude Code to take a customer's React app from zero unit tests to 1,676, with Vitest, MSW and React Testing Library, and 92% statement coverage.

item.title: SEO Case Study: Hamilton Furniture Movers on Page 1
item.description: How we got Move Mate Relocations onto page 1 for "hamilton furniture movers", a generic keyword that was also a website name, with a new blog and social posts.

item.title: How We Cut a Customer's AWS Bill from $2,400 to $800/Month
item.description: A customer's AWS bill was USD 2,400 a month. We merged 13 load balancers into one, ended EKS extended support and cut it to about USD 800 a month.

item.title: AdSense Rejected My Site: Thin Content & E-E-A-T Lessons
item.description: Google AdSense rejected my site Pharmacist Notes for thin content. Here is what I found about E-E-A-T, indexing, AI content and sources, and how I'm fixing it.
